Title: foo 1.2 heap overflow
Author: Jane Doe <jane@example.org>
Posted: 2026-10-02
Revision: 1
News-Item-Format: 2.0
Display-If-Installed: dev-libs/foo:1
Display-If-Installed: <dev-libs/foo-0.9.8:0
Display-If-Installed: app-misc/foo-tools

A crafted archive overflows a heap buffer in libfoo when it is unpacked,
which lets an attacker run code as the user running the extraction.

What to do
==========

    Upgrade to dev-libs/foo-1.2.3 or later, then rebuild every package
    linked against it.
